scope: SRS envelope with structured signature-object support plus the optional subject_ref_origin declaration; profile semantics remain separately versioned.
absence_semantics: An absent field means not declared, full stop; it supports no inference about emitter vintage. Readers and reports render not_declared for absence; no consumer may collapse it into any supplied class.
notes: not_declared is not an enum member and must not appear in the schema. It is the reader-and-report rendering of an absent field, never an emittable value.
Exact-membership rejection stands: the vocabulary is closed and carries no additional-value tolerance.
